body.statement: Chen--Darwiche Theorem 18 states that, when \(C_V=\{P(X)>0:X\text{ is a treatment variable}\}\), \(F\)-identifiability of the causal effect of \(X\) on \(Y\) is equivalent to identifiability after iteratively treating as observed each functional variable whose parents have already been treated as observed.

attestation.note: Scope and positivity family checked against Theorem 18 in the cited source.
